title: Grounding is All You Need? Dual Temporal Grounding for Video Dialog

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: While a segment of current research leans heavily on large-scale pretrained visual-language models and often overlooks temporal dynamics, another delves deep into spatial-temporal relationships within videos but demands intricate object trajectory pre-extractions and sidelines dialog temporal dynamics.
